props.name: acorn_tower_1

Lookout tower, front faces -Y, ladder at the back (+Y). `turret` = the crossbow, origin on its vertical turning axis at the top of the fixed collar, aims -Y; rotate it about its local up axis. `marker_shoot` (child of turret) = bolt tip, where the acorn leaves.
